statement: S103 item 6: which stored observations can be re-derived under current retention and rights rules, which cannot, and why. Counts only; per-revision detail is private.

classes.current: derived by the current extractor and identity rules
classes.rederivable_now_container_only: stale; the page bytes are held in this container only (private evaluation copies)
classes.rederivable_only_by_refetch: stale; the bytes are not held: only a new, authorised fetch can re-derive
classes.not_rederivable_access: stale; bytes not held and the host refused access (suspended)
classes.not_rederivable_rights: stale; retention keeps no values for this source
